name: Soulgasm
source:
Welcome, seeker!

Few reach this island. A handful is allowed to stay.

On the surface, the place looks serene, but taking a closer look you’ll notice that vibrant energy permeates its every corner. Magic? Yes, but of a special kind.

It's Eromancy, the occult discipline that shall make you discover your partners' deepest desires and bend them at your will. Once you learn its ways, you will be ready to share more than a nightstand with your chosen ones.

We find special pride in knowing that Soulgasm shall be your first time using the longing forces of seduction as a key component of the gameplay. These forces are yours to be discovered!

Learn Eromancy, explore the Palace, build relationships, solve the riddles, and find out what the hell is up with this House.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414440/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎，探索者！

很少有人到达这个岛。少数人被允许留下来。

表面上看，这个地方看起来很平静，但仔细观察，你会发现充满活力的能量渗透到它的每个角落。魔法？是的，但是是一种特殊的类型。

这是爱情术，一门神秘的学科，它会让你发现你的伴侣最深的欲望，并按照你的意愿改变它们。一旦你了解了它的方法，你将准备好与你选择的人分享的不仅仅是床头柜。

我们感到特别自豪的是，《Soulgasm》将是你第一次将渴望的诱惑力量作为游戏玩法的关键组成部分。这些力量等待你去发现！

学习浪漫术，探索宫殿，建立关系，解决谜语，并找出这座房子到底发生了什么。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414440/]Steam[/url]]
